earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Symbotic reported revenue of $721 million, up 22% year-over-year, and net income of $55 million, compared with a net loss of $21 million in the third quarter of fiscal year 2025.

quotes.text: We are well on track to deliver against our key objectives for our fiscal year.
quotes.by: Rick Cohen, Symbotic Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

quotes.text: We delivered another quarter of growth and a large expansion in our profitability.
quotes.by: Izzy Martins, Symbotic Chief Financial Officer

outlook: For the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, Symbotic expects revenue of $760 million to $780 million, and adjusted EBITDA 2 of $100 million to $105 million.

items.heading: We are a growing company with a limited operating history and a history of losses. We have not been profitable historically and we may not achieve or maintain profitability in the near term or at all, and it is difficult to evaluate our future prospects and the risks and challenges we may encounter.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry

items.heading: We depend heavily on our larger customers, and therefore, our success is heavily dependent on their ability to grow their businesses and their adoption of our systems.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry

items.heading: We may fail to realize anticipated benefits of the GreenBox joint venture, or it may disrupt our ongoing operations or result in operating difficulties, liabilities and expenses, harm our business, and negatively impact our results of operations.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry

items.heading: Our operating results and financial condition may fluctuate from period to period, which could make our future operating results difficult to predict or cause our operating results to fall below analysts’ and investors’ expectations.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry

items.heading: Our systems may not be successful or meet existing or future requirements in customer agreements with existing or future customers.
items.group: Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry

items.heading: If we are unable to develop new solutions, adapt to technological change, sell our systems, services and software into new markets or further penetrate our existing markets, our revenue may not grow as expected.
